claims.evidence: At 07:30 UTC on November 13, 2026, bitcoin traded at about $69,000, down a little over 6% in 24 hours, after touching an intraday low of $67,922 according to CoinGecko. Based on CoinGlass data analysed by CoinDesk early Friday, more than $1.3 billion in crypto futures were liquidated within 24 hours, about $677 million of them on bitcoin. Per Cointelegraph, data from 10x Research show bitcoin fell 5.9% between November 5 and 12, while the 10-year Treasury yield climbed above 5%. Crypto news at a glance: bitcoin, ether, BNB and XRP this morning Losses run through the large caps, but not evenly. The Crypto Fear and Greed Index from alternative.me reads 20 on Friday, which is "Extreme Fear", down from 28 the day before. This crypto news roundup sets out what is driving the move: forced selling of leveraged positions, outflows from US spot bitcoin ETFs, a strong dollar with rising Treasury yields, and thin order books.
